node.label: SIR & Election Commission
node.summary: Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls, ECI decisions and the political fight over them.

facts.text: The PM called the Opposition 'avrodh paksh' (obstructionist) seeking 'foreign help'; Rahul Gandhi challenged him to a debate.
facts.plain: The PM called the Opposition 'avrodh paksh' (obstructionist) seeking 'foreign help'; Rahul Gandhi challenged him to a debate.

facts.text: The ECI will allow judges to **e-sign** orders on **ECINet** for West Bengal's **19 appellate tribunals**. Over **38 lakh** voter cases are pending out of about **60 lakh** 'doubtful' cases.
facts.plain: The ECI will allow judges to e-sign orders on ECINet for West Bengal's 19 appellate tribunals. Over 38 lakh voter cases are pending out of about 60 lakh 'doubtful' cases.

facts.text: Amit Shah claimed SIR removed about **13 crore** names: 4.25 crore registered twice, 3 crore dead, 1 crore duplicates, plus 3 crore he called 'infiltrators'. These are his claims.
facts.plain: Amit Shah claimed SIR removed about 13 crore names: 4.25 crore registered twice, 3 crore dead, 1 crore duplicates, plus 3 crore he called 'infiltrators'. These are his claims.

facts.text: Editorial: unexplained SIR malpractices could subvert the popular will, and the ECI's silence hurts trust. It also warns against questioning a past election without proof.
facts.plain: Editorial: unexplained SIR malpractices could subvert the popular will, and the ECI's silence hurts trust. It also warns against questioning a past election without proof.

facts.text: The INDIA bloc held a rally at **Ramlila Maidan**, Delhi, against the **Special Intensive Revision (SIR)** of electoral rolls and sought removal of **CEC Gyanesh Kumar**. LoP **Rahul Gandhi** led it.
facts.plain: The INDIA bloc held a rally at Ramlila Maidan, Delhi, against the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls and sought removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. LoP Rahul Gandhi led it.

facts.text: BJP president **Nitin Nabin** accused the Congress of 'protecting three crore infiltrators' during a 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' march in Rohtak on Haryana Foundation Day, countering the INDIA bloc's Ramlila Maidan rally over the SIR.
facts.plain: BJP president Nitin Nabin accused the Congress of 'protecting three crore infiltrators' during a 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' march in Rohtak on Haryana Foundation Day, countering the INDIA bloc's Ramlila Maidan rally over the SIR.

facts.text: *The Hindu* found over 1,000 discrepant entries (garbled names, missing relatives' names) in Bengaluru's final electoral rolls published after the Special Intensive Revision, e.g. in the Dasarahalli Assembly constituency (part 324).
facts.plain: The Hindu found over 1,000 discrepant entries (garbled names, missing relatives' names) in Bengaluru's final electoral rolls published after the Special Intensive Revision, e.g. in the Dasarahalli Assembly constituency (part 324).

facts.text: Rahul Gandhi accused Chief Election Commissioner **Gyanesh Kumar** of 'treason' over the SIR, calling it 'theft of every citizen's voice'; the INDIA bloc held a rally at **Ramlila Maidan**, Delhi, with the Samajwadi Party's Akhilesh Yadav calling it the 'Haldighati of democracy'.
facts.plain: Rahul Gandhi accused Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar of 'treason' over the SIR, calling it 'theft of every citizen's voice'; the INDIA bloc held a rally at Ramlila Maidan, Delhi, with the Samajwadi Party's Akhilesh Yadav calling it the 'Haldighati of democracy'.

facts.text: U.P. CEO **Navdeep Rinwa** asked DEOs to review **Form 6, 6A, 7 and 8** daily on **ECINet**. Form **6A** is for overseas (NRI) electors.
facts.plain: U.P. CEO Navdeep Rinwa asked DEOs to review Form 6, 6A, 7 and 8 daily on ECINet. Form 6A is for overseas (NRI) electors.

facts.text: SC (CJI Surya Kant, Justices **Joymalya Bagchi** and **V. Mohana**) declined to formally extend the **Keralam** SIR deadline, calling roll revision a 'continuing process'; over **24 lakh** names were excluded there.
facts.plain: SC (CJI Surya Kant, Justices Joymalya Bagchi and V. Mohana) declined to formally extend the Keralam SIR deadline, calling roll revision a 'continuing process'; over 24 lakh names were excluded there.

facts.text: Delhi SIR: the ECI pushed the final roll to **22 Dec** (the fourth change). The draft roll of 31 Aug had **97.5 lakh** electors, down from about **1.45 crore**; **47.56 lakh** names marked **ASDD** (Absent, Shifted, Dead, Duplicate) are being re-verified, and BLOs must now record reasons in a new 'Remarks' column.
facts.plain: Delhi SIR: the ECI pushed the final roll to 22 Dec (the fourth change). The draft roll of 31 Aug had 97.5 lakh electors, down from about 1.45 crore; 47.56 lakh names marked ASDD (Absent, Shifted, Dead, Duplicate) are being re-verified, and BLOs must now record reasons in a new 'Remarks' column.

facts.text: Under the **Representation of the People Act**, the authorities for electoral rolls are the **CEO, DEO, ERO and AERO**. Filing a false declaration (e.g. in Form 7) is punishable under **Section 31 of the RP Act, 1950**.
facts.plain: Under the Representation of the People Act, the authorities for electoral rolls are the CEO, DEO, ERO and AERO. Filing a false declaration (e.g. in Form 7) is punishable under Section 31 of the RP Act, 1950.

facts.text: West Bengal SIR: of about **60 lakh** 'doubtful' cases, **700 judicial officers** restored **32,77,360** voters and rejected 27.23 lakh (22 lakh appealed to SC-created **Appellate Tribunals**). The ECI then appealed against **16.10 lakh** cleared voters; Election Commissioners **S.S. Sandhu** and **Vivek Joshi** had questioned such appeals in file notings.
facts.plain: West Bengal SIR: of about 60 lakh 'doubtful' cases, 700 judicial officers restored 32,77,360 voters and rejected 27.23 lakh (22 lakh appealed to SC-created Appellate Tribunals). The ECI then appealed against 16.10 lakh cleared voters; Election Commissioners S.S. Sandhu and Vivek Joshi had questioned such appeals in file notings.

facts.text: ECI told the SC (CJI **Surya Kant** Bench) that 'false' **Form 7s** found during the **U.P. SIR** were not accepted; the SC asked for a compliance report on a plea by Barabanki MP **Tanuj Punia**. The U.P. SIR ended in April and removed over **2 crore** voters.
facts.plain: ECI told the SC (CJI Surya Kant Bench) that 'false' Form 7s found during the U.P. SIR were not accepted; the SC asked for a compliance report on a plea by Barabanki MP Tanuj Punia. The U.P. SIR ended in April and removed over 2 crore voters.

facts.text: A CEC can be removed only like an SC judge (**Article 324(5)**); appointments follow the **CEC and Other ECs (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023** (selection panel: PM, LoP in Lok Sabha, a Union Minister).
facts.plain: A CEC can be removed only like an SC judge (Article 324(5)); appointments follow the CEC and Other ECs (Appointment, Conditions of Service and Term of Office) Act, 2023 (selection panel: PM, LoP in Lok Sabha, a Union Minister).

facts.text: The INDIA bloc held a mock 'public impeachment' of CEC **Gyanesh Kumar** at Congress chief **Mallikarjun Kharge's** residence, presided over by former Lok Sabha Speaker **Meira Kumar**. Reports said two Election Commissioners had differed with the CEC on the SIR.
facts.plain: The INDIA bloc held a mock 'public impeachment' of CEC Gyanesh Kumar at Congress chief Mallikarjun Kharge's residence, presided over by former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar. Reports said two Election Commissioners had differed with the CEC on the SIR.

facts.text: ECI extended SIR deadlines in Maharashtra, Delhi, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Telangana and Nagaland: Maharashtra claims till **13 Nov**, final roll **30 Nov**; Delhi claims till **25 Nov**, disposal by **15 Dec**.
facts.plain: ECI extended SIR deadlines in Maharashtra, Delhi, Andhra Pradesh, Haryana, Telangana and Nagaland: Maharashtra claims till 13 Nov, final roll 30 Nov; Delhi claims till 25 Nov, disposal by 15 Dec.

facts.text: Telangana: of **5,20,331** Form 6 applications filed before the SIR (1 Jan-14 June), **1,92,574 (37%)** were rejected for lacking the SIR declaration form (2002-roll details or one of 12 citizenship documents).
facts.plain: Telangana: of 5,20,331 Form 6 applications filed before the SIR (1 Jan-14 June), 1,92,574 (37%) were rejected for lacking the SIR declaration form (2002-roll details or one of 12 citizenship documents).

facts.text: Editorial on the Delhi SIR hearing: a Bench of CJI **Surya Kant** and Justice **Joymalya Bagchi** said the ECI erred in making deleted voters reapply on **Form 6** as new voters. 'Shifted/absent' deletions rose from **55% in Bihar to 72%** in Phase 3; **Karnataka** deleted about **84 lakh** names.
facts.plain: Editorial on the Delhi SIR hearing: a Bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi said the ECI erred in making deleted voters reapply on Form 6 as new voters. 'Shifted/absent' deletions rose from 55% in Bihar to 72% in Phase 3; Karnataka deleted about 84 lakh names.

facts.text: Electoral roll forms: **Form 6** = new voter registration; **Form 7** = objection to/deletion of a name; **Form 8** = correction, shifting or replacement EPIC. Rolls are prepared under the **Registration of Electors Rules, 1960**.
facts.plain: Electoral roll forms: Form 6 = new voter registration; Form 7 = objection to/deletion of a name; Form 8 = correction, shifting or replacement EPIC. Rolls are prepared under the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960.

facts.text: ECI rules on objections: its **9 Oct** directive caps an individual elector at **10 Form 7s**; a BLA-2 may file up to 10 forms a day only with a signed undertaking; a false declaration in Form 7 is punishable under the **RP Act**. Claims and objections are listed daily on **Form 10**.
facts.plain: ECI rules on objections: its 9 Oct directive caps an individual elector at 10 Form 7s; a BLA-2 may file up to 10 forms a day only with a signed undertaking; a false declaration in Form 7 is punishable under the RP Act. Claims and objections are listed daily on Form 10.

facts.text: Delhi SIR: in **Mustafabad** (north-east Delhi), which has the most **Form 7** objections (843 since 31 Aug), 572 of 597 third-party Form 7s named BJP booth-level agents as objectors and were against Muslim electors; 28 voters marked 'shifted' or 'dead' were found living at home by *The Hindu*.
facts.plain: Delhi SIR: in Mustafabad (north-east Delhi), which has the most Form 7 objections (843 since 31 Aug), 572 of 597 third-party Form 7s named BJP booth-level agents as objectors and were against Muslim electors; 28 voters marked 'shifted' or 'dead' were found living at home by The Hindu.
